import nltk
from string import punctuation
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Constants
PUNCTUATION = set(punctuation)


def task_func(text):
    tokens = nltk.tokenize.regexp_tokenize(
        text,
        r"\$[^\W_]+(?:['’][^\W_]+)*|[^\w\s]",
    )

    valid_words = [
        token
        for token in tokens
        if token.startswith("$")
        and any(character not in PUNCTUATION for character in token[1:])
    ]

    frequency = nltk.FreqDist(valid_words)

    if not frequency:
        return None

    ax = sns.barplot(
        x=list(frequency.keys()),
        y=list(frequency.values()),
    )
    ax.set_xlabel("Words")
    ax.set_ylabel("Frequencies")
    return ax
